title: RED PANDA: The Elusive Master of the Himalayas | Wildlife Documentary
description:
Witness the secret life of the red panda in the high-altitude forests of Asia. From their unique bamboo diet to the delicate bonds of family, discover how these masters of survival navigate their vertical world.

ANIMAL: Red Panda — today's angle: family life.
All footage in this episode is REAL wildlife video, reused legally under Creative Commons / public-domain licenses from the sources listed below.
